jobs.name: crypto-incident-daily
jobs.description: 每日加密货币被盗事件简报
jobs.prompt:
Generate a daily briefing about cryptocurrency theft incidents from the past 24 hours. Search for major crypto hacks, scams, and security incidents. Create a concise report with:

1. Incident summary (what happened, when, amount lost)
2. Type of attack/scam
3. Affected platform/protocol
4. Current status
5. User recommendations

Format the output in Chinese for the USDTRecovery website blog. Include proper SEO keywords and a compelling headline.

jobs.name: case-tracking-update
jobs.description: 案件追踪数据每日更新
jobs.prompt:
Update the case tracking data for USDTRecovery website. Review the current cases and:

1. Check if any cases have new developments
2. Update progress percentages based on latest information
3. Add new case updates to the timeline
4. Update statistics (total recovered, active cases, etc.)
5. Flag any cases ready to be marked as 'recovered' or 'closed'

Generate a JSON update for the case data file.

jobs.name: scam-alert-weekly
jobs.description: 每周诈骗类型分析报告
jobs.prompt:
Generate a weekly scam analysis report covering:

1. Most common scam types of the week
2. Emerging new scam techniques
3. Geographic distribution of victims
4. Total estimated losses
5. Prevention recommendations
6. Trending scam keywords

Format as a blog post in Chinese with data visualization suggestions.

jobs.name: blog-content-monday
jobs.prompt:

- Include call-to-action for consultation

Save to content/blog/ with proper frontmatter.

jobs.name: newsletter-monthly
jobs.prompt:
Generate and send the monthly newsletter for USDTRecovery subscribers:

1. Compile monthly statistics:
   - Total amount recovered this month
   - Number of new cases
   - Number of resolved cases
   - Recovery success rate

2. Featured case updates (3-5 cases)

3. Security alert of the month

4. Top 3 blog posts from the month

5. Upcoming events or announcements

6. Call-to-action for consultation

Use the MonthlyNewsletter email template and send via Resend API.

jobs.name: seo-content-refresh
jobs.prompt:
Review and refresh existing blog content for SEO:

1. Check content-calendar/SEO keywords for target rankings
2. Identify underperforming articles (low traffic)
3. Update outdated information
4. Refresh statistics and examples
5. Add new internal links
6. Improve meta descriptions
7. Update publication dates

Generate a report of changes made and expected improvements.

jobs.name: social-media-daily
jobs.prompt:
Generate daily social media content for USDTRecovery:

1. Twitter/X post (1-2 posts):
   - Security tip or scam warning
   - Industry news comment
   - Engagement question

2. LinkedIn post (if applicable):
   - Professional insight
   - Case study highlight

3. Telegram update:
   - Daily security digest
   - Quick alert if any

Include relevant hashtags and links. Schedule for optimal posting times.
